# Can AMASS be used directly as humanoid motion-tracking labels after it unifies human motion formats?

> **Current answer:** AMASS v1 unifies 15 marker-based mocap datasets in a common human SMPL-H representation. It does not check target-robot joints, contacts, collisions, torque limits, or closed-loop trackability. In an engineering pipeline, AMASS should remain the human-source layer; only robot-specific retargeting and dynamic closed-loop filtering should produce training labels.
